STEP 2 - Vessel: A square white plate, roughly 22 cm across. Area ≈ 22 x 22 ≈ 480 cm² (using the plate's inner area, approximately 400-480 cm²; I use 400 cm²). Food is confined to the lower-center portion.

STEP 3 - Items: Mixed salad leaves (green curly/romaine-type lettuce, spinach-like leaves), red-tinged leaves (radicchio/red lettuce), a small amount of light dressing sheen, and a few small reddish flecks (possibly dried chili or seasoning).

STEP 4 - Area: Mixed leaves ~18% of vessel area; red leaves ~4%; dressing/flecks ~1%. Total covered ≈ 23% (about 92 cm² of 400 cm²).

STEP 5 - Volume: Leaves piled to about 3 cm height. Mixed leaves 72 cm² x 3 cm ≈ 216 ml; red leaves 16 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 32 ml. Total gross ≈ 248 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Loose leafy greens at 0.15 g/ml. Mixed leaves 216 x 0.15 ≈ 32 g; red leaves 32 x 0.15 ≈ 5 g. Dressing ~2 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Mixed leafy greens ~20 kcal/100 g → 32 g ≈ 6 kcal. Red leaves ~23 kcal/100 g → 5 g ≈ 1 kcal. Light vinaigrette/oil ~2 g at 800 kcal/100 g ≈ 16 kcal (only a thin sheen is visible, so kept small).

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A small salad portion of about 40 g with roughly 20-25 kcal is plausible for a few-leaf starter with light dressing that covers only about a quarter of the plate.
